title: SUPER SECRET FINAL LEVEL
status: Cary (collaborator), 2026-10-08: a final, password-protected level, a Final Fantasy style party-based, turn-based battle against Adam Borecki. 'Get the infrastructure part up on the game site'. Everything below except the title, the boss's name and the party members is agent placeholder (tentative): the moves, numbers and words are for Cary and the crew to change.

gate.status: Only the SHA-256 of the password is stored (Cary chose it). On a static public site this is a fun gate, not security: the level's code is in the public repo.

intro: The rehearsal went perfectly. Every mic, every wedge, every line check.
And then the lights flicker. A figure steps out from behind FOH.
Your mentor steps up beside you.
party_status: Cary, 2026-10-08: the party is the player plus the three mentors (Cary, Morgan, Magnolia): 'final fantasy is best with a party of 4!'. The mentor you picked in the main game leads the party (if the game doesn't know, the final level asks). The player types their name. Stats and which skills each person gets are placeholders, not personalities: Cary and the crew decide those.

boss.status: Boss moves are affectionate in-jokes from the project itself (the AES50 'Mute All' flashing is in PRODUCT_DESIGN section 36; the scope ladder is section 91). Placeholder: Cary and Adam decide.

victory: Everyone earned 0 EXP, and the respect of Salmon Recital Hall.

rules.status: Damage = (attacker atk x 2 - target def) x power x variance, at least 1; magic uses mag. Defending halves damage for that round. Turn order each round is by speed. Placeholders.

player.status: the player is the A2 from the main game; no photo, the page draws an avatar
